claimScope: Only the named passages were read. This does not verify every claim, historical citation or normative conformance in the parent models.

sources.edition: ODRL Information Model 2.2, W3C Recommendation, 15 February 2018
sources.observed: The model separates policy validation from evaluation and names permission, prohibition and duty. Conflict handling is explicit, defaulting to invalid; an unrecognized declared profile stops processing.
sources.inference: Our reference must distinguish a well-formed declaration from a current serving decision and reject unsupported policy semantics.
sources.limit: Conceptual comparison only; no ODRL serializer, evaluator or conformance claim.

sources.edition: ODRL Vocabulary and Expression 2.2, W3C Recommendation, 15 February 2018
sources.observed: Purpose is a rule-action operand; anonymize is an action vocabulary term.
sources.inference: Naming an action supplies neither an implemented transformation nor a measured disclosure guarantee.
sources.limit: No anonymization algorithm or quantitative privacy mechanism is imported.

sources.observed: ABAC evaluates subject, object, operation and context attributes under policy. Decision, enforcement, information and administration are distinct cooperating functions.
sources.inference: A package review artifact must not present itself as enforcement. Host authentication, fresh attributes and atomic serving controls are separate integration requirements.
sources.limit: No complete ABAC implementation or NIST certification is claimed.

sources.observed: Repeated releases and external data can create disclosure risks despite vetted individual queries. Review boards provide accountable governance; project, people, data, setting and output risks require distinct consideration.
sources.inference: Pin the exact combination and its relevant prior-release context. A positive manual review is an attributed assessment, not a mathematical guarantee against inference.
sources.limit: US government guidance is used for design comparison, not a universal enterprise law or a claim of anonymization.

sectionsRead: How deletes work with S3 Object Lock
sources.observed: Retention and hold protection attaches to object versions. A hold can remain after retention expires. A simple delete may create a delete marker while leaving a protected version intact.
sources.inference: Stop-serving, a deletion marker, actual version destruction and verified disposal must be separate records; a hold and retention schedule are independent constraints.
sources.limit: This is a concrete storage counterexample, not an S3 adapter or general legal-retention rule. No vendor-specific code is copied.
